criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
criteria.evidence: Official Purdue GIS FID 85 identifies Benjamin Harrison Residence Hall at 107 Macarthur Drive; independently projected 28-vertex polygon matches the evaluated base perimeter (28 vertices; symmetric nearest-vertex error 0.000561 m).
criteria.limitation: Official campus-map polygon is not a certified survey.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, and scale/dimensions
criteria.evidence: Manifest placement origin [-1110.0, -260.0] m plus the local frame maps the full GIS vertex pattern to the model; source ring comparison independently confirms plan shape, scale and orientation. Evaluated local XYZ bounds: [[-75.0, 75.0], [-85.0, 85.0], [-0.05999999865889549, 30.350000381469727]] m.
criteria.limitation: Position, orientation and dimensions are awarded from GIS/manifest geometry only. No dimensions or heading were inferred from the unregistered perspective photograph; the local meters-per-degree transform is approximate.

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.evidence: Purdue OEP source states three major wings, 8 stories in each north/south wing and 2 in the central section; those relative masses and story bands are represented in the reopened model and fresh views.
criteria.limitation: No authoritative total elevation, floor datums, floor-to-floor dimensions or roof-form evidence. The photo is perspective and is not used to infer vertical dimensions.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive architecture
criteria.status: photo-backed cues; dimensions and orientation unverified
criteria.evidence: Direct visual comparison of the archived Purdue hero photo with the fresh Cam_West_Entrance render supports four broad cues: red-brown brick on wings/connector; repeated vertically stacked narrow windows; a light perforated screen across the lower connector; and glazed entrance adjoining a broad light canopy. The listed Blender object anchors all exist in the reopened export: HARR_Center_Pavilion_Main_Brick, HARR_Center_West_Entrance_Bay, HARR_Entrance_Canopy_Fascia, HARR_Entrance_Canopy_Slab, HARR_NorthTower_North_Frames, HARR_North_Tower_Brick_Core, HARR_Screen_End_Pier_N, HARR_Screen_End_Pier_S, HARR_Screen_Top_Beam, HARR_SouthTower_South_Frames, HARR_South_Tower_Brick_Core, HARR_West_Solar_Screen_Grid.
criteria.limitation: Photograph compass direction and camera registration are unknown. It cannot establish wing-to-compass assignment, exact window width/spacing, screen dimensions/pattern, canopy dimensions, lettering, unseen elevations, or precise facade geometry.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
criteria.evidence: Canonical builder reran in an isolated replica and emitted three fresh views. Actual asset reopened in Blender 4.5.15 LTS; named collection has 220 objects and exact manifest membership. Collection-only export reopened with 220 objects, no camera/light objects, no unpacked external images and no linked libraries. Source snapshots and image are recorded with SHA256 hashes.
criteria.limitation: Opening asset emits an unavailable legacy BLENDER_EEVEE identifier warning in Blender 4.5; builder switches to EEVEE Next in-memory for successful renders.

findings: The new official exterior photograph supports broad color/material and composition cues but remains unregistered; it did not change or validate placement, orientation, dimensions, exact facade geometry, or roof.
GIS identity and plan geometry are independently verified; local placement/scale/orientation derive from that polygon and the manifest origin.
Height, floor datums, total height and roof remain partly/unverified; the OEP source supports story arrangement only.
No building/model/builder/shared-index files were changed for this independent grade; the canonical builder ran against an isolated copy.
